dorothy_federated_learning_raspberry_pi.description: 도로시가 라즈베리파이 클러스터로 개인정보보호 연합학습을 실험하는 씬
dorothy_federated_learning_raspberry_pi.positive_prompt: {style_prefix}. {dorothy_core} sitting at a lab desk, excitedly observing a cluster of three small green Raspberry Pi boards connected with ethernet cables and blinking LEDs, training a distributed federated learning model. {jiny_core} sits next to the monitor inspecting the decentralized loss graphs. {toto_core} happily sits under the desk holding a loose ethernet cable. High-tech cozy classroom maker lab.

dorothy_docker_containers_fastapi.description: 도로시가 Dockerfile과 docker-compose로 웹 서버와 DB를 컨테이너로 빌드하는 씬
dorothy_docker_containers_fastapi.positive_prompt: {style_prefix}. {dorothy_core} at her dual-monitor developer desk, cheering with both fists pumped in the air as a Docker container build succeeds with a cheerful blue Docker whale logo on the screen alongside FastAPI code. {jiny_core} nods approvingly from the keyboard. Warm glowing maker lab background.

dorothy_database_sql_mysql_postgres.description: 도로시가 MySQL과 PostgreSQL 데이터베이스 스키마와 SQL 쿼리를 공부하는 씬
dorothy_database_sql_mysql_postgres.positive_prompt: {style_prefix}. {dorothy_core} pointing a pencil at an ERD database diagram and SQL table schemas (PostgreSQL and MySQL) on a large computer screen, learning database normalization and indexing. {hojin_core} stands beside her pointing encouragingly at the query optimization plan.

dorothy_java_enterprise_oop.description: 도로시가 자바 객체지향 4대 원칙과 클래스 다이어그램을 공부하는 씬
dorothy_java_enterprise_oop.positive_prompt: {style_prefix}. {dorothy_core} seated before a glass whiteboard drawing UML class inheritance diagrams and Java interfaces with colorful dry-erase markers. An open Java textbook and a steaming ceramic mug with a coffee bean logo sit on the desk.

dorothy_php_web_migration.description: 도로시가 PHP 레거시 웹 코드를 현대식 REST API 구조로 리팩토링하는 씬
dorothy_php_web_migration.positive_prompt: {style_prefix}. {dorothy_core} comparing old PHP code and new Python FastAPI code side by side on a split-screen monitor, holding her chin in deep concentration with a curious maker smile. Beside her is a small purple elephant plush toy.

hojin_teaching_federated_learning.description: 이호진 교수님이 칠판에 분산 엣지 기기와 연합학습 FedAvg 수식을 강의하는 씬
hojin_teaching_federated_learning.positive_prompt: {style_prefix}. {hojin_core} standing in front of a green university lecture chalkboard, drawing distributed client nodes, edge devices, and the mathematical formula for Federated Averaging (FedAvg). Warm intellectual mentor aura.

jiny_reviewing_docker_code.description: 조교 지니가 안경을 쓰고 Dockerfile의 멀티스테이지 캐시 순서를 매섭게 검토하는 씬
jiny_reviewing_docker_code.positive_prompt: {style_prefix}. {jiny_core} sitting upright on a wooden desk, peering through round spectacles at a terminal screen displaying Dockerfile commands, one paw pointing at a cached layer line. Serious and adorable technical code review.

toto_hardware_pi_assistant.description: 토토가 라즈베리파이 GPIO 점퍼 와이어를 입에 물고 신나게 달려오는 씬
toto_hardware_pi_assistant.positive_prompt: {style_prefix}. {toto_core} trotting happily across a wooden lab floor, carrying a colorful ribbon cable and jumper wires in its mouth to deliver to Dorothy's electronics workbench. Bouncing fluffy fur, sky-blue bandana fluttering.
